title: Stand Up Paddle Boarding Adventure in Windward Oahu
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the serene beauty of Windward Oahu as you glide through its lush jungles on a stand-up paddle board. Starting with a quick tutorial, you’ll be ready to navigate the tranquil waters surrounded by stunning scenery. This mellow paddle experience is perfect for all skill levels, allowing you to connect with nature while soaking in the vibrant atmosphere of paradise. Enjoy convenient transportation from Waikiki for groups of five or fewer, making it an easy escape into the great outdoors.
